description: Use when the user wants an elicitative interview — reaching alignment on a plan, decision, or idea by drawing out their decisions, unstated opinions, silent assumptions, and thoughts they find hard to put into words, through rounds of pointed questions. Triggers: "grill me", "interview me about this", "make sure we're aligned", "make sure you understand what I want", "help me pin down the decisions", "what am I assuming", "help me figure out what I actually want".
